name: gen-image
description: Generate and edit images via Google's Gemini image models (nano banana) — single-shot text-to-image, image editing, and style-referenced generation from a zero-dependency Node CLI.

prerequisites.name: node
prerequisites.install_hint: Install Node.js from https://nodejs.org/ — the gen-image CLI is a Node script.

install.notes: No software to install; the CLI ships inside the skill folder. Requires a Google AI Studio API key — see post_install_hints.

post_install_hints: gen-image needs a Google AI Studio API key (https://aistudio.google.com/apikey).
Set it once per machine: environment variable GOOGLE_API_KEY (preferred), or write it to ~/.claude/.google-api-key.
Per-project override: a GOOGLE_API_KEY= line in the project's .env (must be gitignored).
